text:
tara: FYI the staging image checker failed during the hardening pipeline: cosign reported 'public key not available' for base-image-20260323
sec-bot: [ALERT] cosign verify: key lookup failed for projects/redwood-kms/locations/global/keyRings/rotation/cryptoKeys/builder-key : PermissionDenied
josh: did we run a key rotation tonight? I thought rotation was scheduled for next week
tara: rotation automation kicked due to TTL policy, but the final step failed. KMS shows keyVersion setPrimary v5 at 03:12Z but the signer service couldn't read v5
emma: signer logs show 403 when calling KMS GetPublicKey with svc-signer principal starting at 03:13Z
priya: that smells like an RBAC change landed around the same time. running an audit query now
priya: audit: IAM binding update at 03:10Z removed role roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyEncrypterDecrypter from group:ci-ops, then terraform rotated key at 03:12Z
josh: removing that role would block signer from using key versions depending on our setup. oncall, pause any rebuilds?
oncall: pausing scheduled image rebuilds for 1h. creating incident INC-5001
compliance: tagging incident; we'll need KMS audit logs and terraform plan diff for evidence. extend retention for the 2h window
tara: plan proposal: 1) revert IAM diff to restore encrypter/decrypter for svc-signer 2) restart signer service so it can fetch v5 3) re-run cosign verify on staging canaries 4) delay unrelated baseimage rebuilds (e.g., glibc patch) until stability
emma: + add a preflight that checks signer can call GetPublicKey for the new primary before rotation completes
priya: applying revert PR now; please review urgently
josh: approved and applied. iam restored at 03:36Z according to logs
sec-bot: KMS audit: GetPublicKey calls from svc-signer now returning OK at 03:37Z
tara: restarting signer pods (rolling) ... restart done
tara: cosign verify -> PASS on staging canary :white_check_mark:
compliance: collected KMS audit snippets and terraform plan; saving to INC-5001 evidence bundle
priya: follow-ups: - add terraform guardrail preventing removal of cryptoKeyEncrypterDecrypter from signer principals - add CI test for key-version alias alignment - schedule separate window for glibc rebuild (don't overlap with rotations)
josh: i'll draft the guardrail PR and the pre-rotation validator. aiming EOD
tara: i'll coordinate the glibc rebuild slot with eng-runtime next week. marking incident mitigated for now
sec-bot: INC-5001 -> mitigated (evidence stored). monitor next rotation cycle closely
